M: Good morning ladies and gentlemen. This is train 101 going to Southport. We will stop at Bear Town at 10 o’clock, Grand Park at 12 o’clock, and arrive at Southport at 2 o’clock. Snacks and meals are for sale at car 3. Hope you enjoy your trip with us. Thank you.
Q: What do we know about train 101?
o: You can buy lunch on the train.
The train arrives at the last station before noon.
